source_note.zh: 上海计算机/IT相关岗位记录（含历史与未确认条目）。当前 85 家公司、174 条岗位、82 门课程、111 个技能有课程映射。岗位为选录，非雇主空缺总量，不等于当前在招。
source_note.en: Shanghai computing/IT role records (including historical and unconfirmed entries). 85 companies, 174 role records, 82 courses, 111 skills with course mappings. Selected records, not live vacancy totals.

company_selection_rule: Verified Shanghai workplace records may appear with zero roles, explicitly marked as role verification pending. Individual jobs require their own source; published is not the same as currently open. Unverified coordinates are never plotted.

preview_review.policy: Around ten companies per neighbourhood as a guide, with more in genuinely dense areas; no hard district cap. Office-only entries allowed. Conflicting locations and unavailable brand assets are held out of preview.
